item.title: FX Retail via BHIM Bharat Connect: An 11-Day Lien and What It Actually Cost
item.description: A failed FX Retail booking via BHIM Bharat Connect put a substantial sum under lien for 11 days, with BHIM, ICICI, and FX Retail each pointing at the others. The money came back — the July 31 entry window it was meant for never did. The full account, and what it actually cost.
